caption: The drawing features a fabric swatch with a plaid or checkered pattern, rendered in shades of blue and white. The swatch is square and positioned near the upper left quadrant of the page, with its top and left edges parallel to the edges of the drawing. The plaid consists of horizontal and vertical stripes of varying widths in dark blue, medium blue, and thin black lines, intersecting to form a grid with differently sized rectangles and squares. The background of the fabric is a very light blue or off-white color. There are two small circular marks labeled “cc” in the upper central region of the fabric. On the bottom right corner of the page, outside the swatch, the name “Chas. Goodwin” is written in plain black lettering. The background of the page is a solid light beige.
